sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited data type with an empty case expression is exhaustive, allowing a function from impossibility to any type.
sketches.resonance: When nothing can arrive, nothing can be refuted, and absence is permitted to become anything.

sketches.mechanism: A mutable default argument is evaluated once at function definition time and shared by all later calls.
sketches.resonance: What looked like a temporary place quietly keeps everyone who has ever passed through it.

sketches.mechanism: The equals sign performs pattern matching under single assignment, so rebinding succeeds only if the value already matches.
sketches.resonance: A vow cannot overwrite the other; it can only continue where sameness is true.
